notes: A valid line is exactly IP IDENT USER [TIMESTAMP] "METHOD PATH PROTOCOL" STATUS BYTES, single-space separated (TIMESTAMP is everything inside the brackets; every other field has no spaces), STATUS has exactly 3 digits and BYTES is a non-negative integer or "-" (counts as 0); any other line (including blank ones) only increments "malformed". Return {"status_counts": {status as a string: count}, "top_endpoints": up to 5 [path, count] pairs sorted by count desc then path asc, "error_rate": 4xx+5xx lines / valid lines (0.0 if none), "total_bytes": int, "malformed": int}; PATH is used as-is. In Java, return a Map<String, Object> holding a Map<String, Integer>, a List<List<Object>> of {path, count}, a double, a long (bytes can exceed int) and an int.
